description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: View freshness
spec.description: Age of each independent retained API view. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, view) (clamp_min(time() - (solver_bot_workflow_last_observation_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator"}), 0) * ((solver_bot_workflow_last_observation_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator"}) > bool 0))

spec.title: Activity and backlog ages
spec.description: Comparable process-local ages; zero means no continuous backlog or activity observed. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Offer submission counts
spec.description: Accepted and failed API submissions over time. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Accepted offer amounts
spec.description: Principal and expected-yield atomic units remain separated by token. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: API operation p95
spec.description: Latency trend for each fixed 3F API operation. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, operation) (rate(solver_bot_external_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Request backlog trend
spec.description: Outstanding exposure and immediately redeemable work over time. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, view) (solver_bot_workflow_observed_items{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",view=~"active_requests|redeemable"})

spec.title: Redeem transaction outcomes
spec.description: Transaction outcomes only. Request-count workflow events are shown separately and are not added to transaction counts. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: sum(max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, view) (solver_bot_workflow_observed_items{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",view="active_requests"}))
sum(max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, view) (solver_bot_workflow_observed_items{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",view="redeemable"}))

min((max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, event, outcome) (clamp_min(time() - (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",event="offer",outcome="success"}[$__range])), 0) * ((max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",event="offer",outcome="success"}[$__range])) > bool 0))) > 0) or (sum(max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, event, outcome) (clamp_min(time() - (max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",event="offer",outcome="success"}[$__range])), 0) * ((max_over_time(solver_bot_workflow_last_event_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator",event="offer",outcome="success"}[$__range])) > bool 0))) == 0)

spec.title: Current view counts
spec.description: Current authoritative target, offer, request, and redeemable counts. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, solver, strategy, view) (solver_bot_workflow_observed_items{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="3f-bridge-facilitator"})

spec.title: Pod details
spec.description: Per-pod values. Counters cover the selected interval; readiness and gauges use current samples. Retired pods have no current state.

title: Vault Solver · 3F Facilitator

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
